spans.s: मुमुक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, desiring emancipation.

मुमुक्षा, f. desire of liberation or final eman-
cipation.

मुमुक्षा मुमुक्षा, मुमुक्षु. See p. 783,
col. 2.

मुमुक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of freeing, wish-
ing to deliver or liberate; eager to be free (from
mundane existence), striving after emancipation;
wishing to let go or give up; wishing to emit or
discharge; about to shoot; (उस्), m. a sage striving
after emancipation.
—मुमुक्षु-ता, f. or मुमु-
क्षु-त्व, अम्, n. desire of liberation or of final
emancipation.

मुमुचान मुमुचान, मुमुचु. See p. 783,
col. 2.

मुमुचु, उस्, m. (mentioned with Un-mucu and
Pra-mucu), N. of a Ṛṣi.

मुमोचयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of liberating,
wishing to set free.
मुमुरत् मुमुरत्. See under rt. मृ.

मुमुषिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to steal, intend-
ing to rob; (उस्), m. a thief, robber.
—मुमुषिषु-
वत्, ind. like a thief.
मुमूर्षा मुमूर्षा, मुमूर्षु. See rt. मृ.

मुमूर्षा, f. (fr. Desid.), desire of death, wishing
to die, being at the point of death, impatience of life.

मुमोक्षयिषु मुमोक्षयिषु. See under rt.
मोक्ष्, p. 797, col. 2.

मुमोक्षयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.),
wishing to set free, desiring to liberate.
मुम्मडिदेव मुम्मडि-देव, अस्, m. a proper N.
मुम्मुनि मुम्मुनि, इस्, m. a proper N.

मुमूर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to die, being about
to die, being at the point of death.
